items.title: Blue chips get the blues: Top 10’s MCap share hits decade low
items.summary: India's top 10 listed blue-chip companies are experiencing a decline in market capitalisation share. This decline is attributed to sustained foreign portfolio investor selling and large-cap stock underperformance. The top 10 companies now account for around 17.65% of the total market capitalisation as of October 9. Despite this, domestic flows are supporting the broader market and smaller companies are outperforming…

items.title: Singapore Bank Selloff Tests the City-State’s Safe Haven Status
items.summary: A selloff in Singapore bank shares driven by fears of earnings downgrades is threatening one of Asia’s best-performing major stock benchmarks this year, putting the city-state’s safe haven status to the test.

items.title: Oil Holds Advance as Expanding Middle East War Threatens Supply
items.summary: Oil held a gain as a widening conflict in the Middle East threatened to hamper a recovery in supply from the region, while there were also doubts over US President Donald Trump’s claims of an “energy ceasefire” between Russia and Ukraine.

items.title: US stocks: Nasdaq ends lower as oil prices surge ahead of earnings, economic data
items.summary: The Nasdaq composite index faced a downturn as oil prices surged following attacks on a Saudi airport. With major banks set to release their earnings reports, investor focus sharpens this week. The S&P 500 and Dow Jones saw mixed performances, while the energy sector thrived. Heightened inflation concerns due to rising oil costs have begun to sway investor confidence, mirroring a cautious market atmosphere tied to…

items.title: Centre & states to draft rules for existing arrest cases under GST
items.summary: The Centre will collaborate with states to create standard procedures for handling arrest cases. Starting April 1, 2027, an invoice management system will be mandatory, minimizing human errors during digital matching. A quarterly review of GST refund risk assessment will also be implemented to maintain consistency across jurisdictions. The proposed changes aim to decriminalize several GST offences and decrease…

items.title: India draws $351 billion in greenfield FDI, outpaces China
items.summary: Speaking to ET, Nikolaus Lang, managing director & senior partner at BCG highlighted the Indian market as the biggest draw for investors amid a sweeping global realignment. He, however, stressed on sustained focus on infrastructure development, skilling and cost competitiveness for India to further enhance its manufacturing footprint on a global scale.

items.title: Wheat sowing faces heat from water shortage this winter
items.summary: Farmers in India are likely to reduce wheat planting this winter due to water scarcity and low minimum support prices. Regions such as Rajasthan, Gujarat, and Madhya Pradesh may see the most significant impact from these conditions. The state governments are encouraging farmers to consider crops that require less water, which may lead to a shift in crop choices.

items.title: Demand for Crude Oil May Have Peaked Last Year, FGE Says
items.summary: Demand for crude oil may have peaked in 2025, partly as higher need for fuels is increasingly met by biofuels, according to FGE NexantECA.

items.title: Assocham seeks review of bidders' qualificationfor transmission units
items.summary: Assocham has suggested that the ministry improve technical qualification requirements for companies involved in transmission projects. This proposal aims to ensure that only experienced developers participate in the bidding process. The current framework allows companies to qualify based on broad infrastructure experience, which may delay project execution. The association recommends that qualifications be tailored…

items.title: Cleveland Fed's Hammack backs restrictive policy, says better if it comes 'relatively quickly'
items.summary: Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack has stressed the urgency of adopting a strict monetary policy as a response to mounting inflation that now permeates various sectors, not just energy. She advocates for prompt adjustments to keep inflation on target at 2%, emphasizing transparency in Fed policies to aid both households and businesses in their financial planning amidst rising prices.

items.title: JPMorgan, Goldman Curb Exposure on $5 Billion Volta AI Loan Sale
items.summary: JPMorgan Chase & Co. and Goldman Sachs Group Inc. have taken a rare move to limit their exposure on a $5 billion loan sale for AI startup Volta Infrastructure Holdings Ltd. as investors demand higher yields for risky debt tied to the artificial intelligence boom.

items.title: Dividend, rights issue record date: Last chance to buy today to qualify for amount- Vedanta, TCS, Continental Controls
items.summary: Vedanta, TCS, Continental Controls and Energy Infrastructure Trust have set October 14 as the record date for announced corporate actions.

items.summary: The two sides also agreed to exchange data annually on the use of CETA, which came into effect on July 15. The data will cover businesses' claims for lower tariffs and feedback on implementation, beginning a year after the pact comes into force. "Communities across the UK and India are set to benefit from over £1 billion in new deals.

items.title: US Stocks: Dating app Bumble shares surge 52% on talks to go private at $1 billion valuation
items.summary: Bumble is reportedly in advanced negotiations for a private acquisition by Ithaca Holdings, which values the company at approximately $1 billion. This potential acquisition follows a decline in Bumble's market valuation, which was around $389 million recently. Shares of Bumble saw a significant increase, which rose nearly 52% after the acquisition discussions became public. The company is facing challenges in a…

items.title: US bank stocks near correction as earnings loom, consumer outlook in focus
items.summary: US bank stocks are nearing correction territory ahead of earnings, with investors watching for clues on consumer resilience amid elevated borrowing costs and rising Treasury yields. While trading revenue is expected to remain strong, analysts are divided on the outlook, weighing potential relief rallies against macroeconomic risks and growing concerns over credit affordability.

items.title: HCLTech beats estimates, but Q2 growth slips to three-year low
items.summary: HCL Tech’s advanced AI revenue jumped 28% sequentially to $219 million, while net profit jumped 10.25% during the same period to $538 million.

items.title: RBL Bank expects to put most FCNR(B) funds to profitable use in 2-3 years
items.summary: RBL Bank expects its net interest margin to decline in the December quarter as the cost of about ₹34,000 crore raised through FCNR(B) deposits kicks in, while much of the funds remain parked in lower-yielding investments.

items.title: No economic settlement reached in TVS family: Lakshmi Venu, Mallika
items.summary: Lakshmi Venu and Mallika Srinivasan say no agreement has been reached on economic ownership within the Venu Srinivasan family, calling for a fair and transparent settlement

items.title: Sir Dorabji Tata Trust gets a week more to respond to complaints by two trustees
items.summary: SDTT, which holds 27.98% of Tata Sons, has sought an extension to respond to the Charity Commissioner’s queries on complaints filed against it. The deadline is now extended to 19 October.

items.summary: The annual data exchange, starting July 2027, aims to help small businesses leverage lower import duties and resolve early operational hurdles following the trade pact's implementation.

items.summary: Broader market indices bucked the trend, with the Nifty Midcap 150 rising 0.1 per cent and the Nifty Smallcap 250 gaining 1.13 per cent

items.title: Defence startup Tonbo Imaging fixes IPO price band at ₹665-700 a share

items.title: US tariffs accelerate global trade realignment: How India’s FTAs could boost GDP
items.summary: India’s expanding free trade agreements (FTAs) could add $140 billion to GDP and boost exports by 6.2% by 2035, according to Bloomberg Economics. Here’s how trade deals, US tariffs and global supply chain shifts could shape India’s growth.
